recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future MedicationAdministration scope changes should be handled through a new Pharmacy work-group decision rather than by narrowing the already-applied FHIR-5521 wording.
issue_request: FHIR-5521 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Pharmacy change request raised in DSTU1 asking to clarify MedicationAdministration scope with the sentence: "Describes the event of a patient consuming or otherwise being administered a medication."
initial_application: No commit explicitly tagged FHIR-5521 was found. Historical source shows the request was applied in git-svn mirror commit abce09d8c1, which changed the old MedicationAdministration spreadsheet definition from "a patient being given a dose of a medication" to the requested consuming/administered wording; later source refactors carried it into the current StructureDefinition XML.
additional_context: MedicationAdministration is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition description and root element definition both retain the requested sentence, while nearby narrative scope/boundary text remains consistent. Later Published issue FHIR-37337 explains the additional waste-recording sentence now present in the resource description, so that extra text should be preserved.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Editing the current source would either duplicate existing text or remove later compatible guidance, so no source-changing reconciliation was appropriate.
